sections.title: First sign-in
sections.lead: Open the link from the EHS Center in your phone browser. We suggest "Add to Home screen" so it opens like an app.
steps: Tap your department.
Tap your name in the list.
Enter the 4-digit PIN from the EHS Center.
Tap "Confirm, I am ○○○" at the bottom. You sign in only once; afterwards it opens straight to Home.
sections.tip: Keep your PIN to yourself. If you forget it, ask the EHS Center to reset it.

sections.title: Signature (only once)
sections.lead: Your signature is saved and added automatically each time you submit — no daily signing.
shots: You can also upload a photo
steps: In the box, sign your full name horizontally with your finger; or sign with a black pen on white paper, take a photo and tap "Upload signature photo" — the background is removed automatically.
Tap "Next: vertical signature"; the system turns it vertical and shows you.
If every character is complete and in order, tap "Use this vertical one". If not, tap "I will sign myself" and sign top to bottom in the box.
sections.tip: To change your signature later: Home → "Settings" → "My signature". Every step has a "Back" button at the bottom. Picked the wrong name? On the first signature step tap "Choose again" to return to "Who are you?"; you will need to enter your PIN again.

sections.title: Understanding Home
sections.lead: The top of Home tells you how many things are left today. Just work through "To do" from top to bottom.
steps: Dark blue box: how many things are left today and the daily-check progress bar.
To do: today's forms, returned items to fix, periodic inspections due soon, monthly submission — work from top to bottom.
Tiles below: My forms, Ask a coworker, Notices, Calendar, Monthly records, Reminders, Settings.
"Online / Offline" at top right: you can still fill in offline; it uploads when the network is back.

sections.title: Android: put the App on your home screen
sections.lead: Once it is on your home screen you open it from the icon like any other app, without hunting for the link — and you need this to get reminder notifications later.
steps: Open the App link in Chrome. If you opened it inside LINE, first tap ⋮ at the top right → Open in Chrome (LINE's built-in browser cannot add to the home screen).
Tap the three dots ⋮ at the top right of Chrome.
Choose Add to Home screen or Install app (the wording differs by phone — tap whichever you see).
In the pop-up tap Install or Add; some phones ask again — tap Add to Home screen.
Go back to your home screen and find the App icon; always open the App from there. If it is not on the home screen, swipe up to the list of all apps.
sections.tip: On Samsung phones using the built-in Internet browser: tap ≡ at the bottom → Add page to → Home screen.

sections.title: iPhone: put the App on your home screen
sections.lead: On iPhone you must use Safari to add it to the home screen.
steps: Open the App link in Safari. If you opened it inside LINE, tap ⋯ at the bottom right → Open in Safari.
Tap the Share button at the bottom centre (a square with an up arrow).
Scroll down and choose Add to Home Screen.
Tap Add at the top right.
Go back to the home screen and open the App from its icon.
sections.tip: On iPhone the home-screen App and Safari are separate: if you signed in in Safari, sign in once more after adding it (only once). Reminder notifications need iOS 16.4 or later.

chapters.title: Inspector
chapters.who: Check before work every day, submit once a month

sections.title: Daily checks
sections.lead: Before work, open today's form, check each item and submit.
steps: On Home, under "To do", tap "Start checking".
If everything is fine, tap "All OK" to tick all at once. For a problem item tap "Abnormal"; a note box appears — describe the problem and what you did (required).
If there is no work that day, tap "No work today".
The bottom button shows the next step: items left, items needing a note. When all is done it becomes "Submit this form".
Your signature is added when you submit. To change it the same day, open the same form, edit and submit again.
sections.tip: Use "Not ticked" / "Abnormal" at the top to show only those items — handy for long forms.

sections.title: Calendar · Fill in missed days
sections.lead: Tap a missed day on the calendar to fill it in.
steps: On Home tap "Calendar · Fill in missed days".
Green = checked, red = abnormal, grey dashed = weekday with no record.
Use "‹ previous month" / "next month ›" at the top, or swipe left or right on the calendar to change month (swipe right for the previous month).
Tap a missed day to fill it in (months not yet submitted, back to the 1st of the month 3 months ago).
Switch forms at the top. "Table (by item)" shows every item for the whole month.
Missed several days: on the month page tap "Fill in all". Forms open one by one and jump to the next after you send.
The orange box shows your progress. You can skip a form or stop; if you leave, Home shows "Continue".
sections.tip: Please check and fill in on the same day. Late entries record the time and are visible to supervisors and EHS.

sections.title: My forms
sections.lead: Every form assigned to you and periodic inspection deadlines, on one page.
steps: On Home tap "My forms".
Daily checks: whether today's is done.
Periodic inspections: monthly, yearly and 2-yearly forms with last date and next deadline; Home reminds you 30 days before.
Tap any form to start.
sections.tip: Yearly and 2-yearly inspections have no fixed day — inspect on site before the deadline, then fill in.

sections.title: Yearly and 2-yearly inspections (photos and notes required)
sections.lead: Forms that need a detailed on-site inspection — local exhaust, chemical equipment, ovens, boilers, elevators — must include evidence.
steps: These forms have no "All OK" — inspect each item on site and tick them one by one.
Scroll to "Inspection evidence" at the bottom and write inspection notes (at least 15 characters: what you checked, how, and the readings).
Tap "Take / choose photo" and take at least 2: the parts checked, meter readings or the nameplate. They upload right away (network needed); tap × at top right to remove a wrong one.
When everything is in, the bottom button becomes "Submit this form". Supervisors see the notes and photos, and they are printed in the monthly PDF.

sections.title: Ask a coworker to fill in (on leave)
sections.lead: When you're on leave, a coworker can fill in that day's daily check.
steps: On Home tap "Ask a coworker to fill in" and choose the day (up to 7 days ahead).
Tap "Create fill-in link" and send it to your coworker on LINE.
The coworker doesn't sign in; they open the link, fill in the day's form, and sign by hand on the spot when sending.
The link only works on that day and expires at 23:59.

sections.title: Claim forms
sections.lead: You can claim forms or equipment that are open for your section but not yet assigned to you.
steps: At the bottom of "My forms" tap "Claim other forms or equipment in this section".
Find the form or equipment and tap "Claim".
It then appears on Home. To cancel, ask your supervisor or the EHS Center.

sections.title: Monthly submission (once a month)
sections.lead: After each month, the whole section's records go to the supervisor for review. Any one person can send them.
steps: From the 1st of the next month, Home shows "Submit the records for month ○" (due by the 5th).
Check the calendar for missed days and fill them in, then tap "Month done — lock and send to the supervisor".
The check page lists how many days each form was done. Tick "I have checked nothing is missing" and tap "Confirm and submit".
After sending it is locked and cannot be changed; to change it, the supervisor must return it. Before the supervisor reviews it, the sender can withdraw it.

sections.title: Notices and announcements
sections.lead: Assignment changes, returns and EHS Center announcements all appear in the app.
shots: Announcement at the top of Home
Read full text on the Notices page
steps: EHS Center announcements appear in a red box at the top of Home. Tap "Read full text".
After you read it, it leaves Home; you can see it again in "Notices".
Changes to your forms or equipment and returned months are also explained in Notices.
Do not want some emails (for example the filed-record email with PDFs)? "Settings" → "Email settings", uncheck it and save; you still get the notices in the app.

sections.title: Issue tracking (corrective actions)
sections.lead: Items marked "Abnormal" move to "Issue tracking" automatically. An issue closes only when you record how it was fixed.
shots: You can attach photos of issues
steps: When an item is marked "abnormal", besides the note you can tap "Add photo (optional)" to take a photo or pick one already on your phone.
After submitting, the item appears in "Issue tracking" (red box on Home; the supervisor is notified). If it happens again before being fixed, it is added to the same issue, not duplicated.
When fixed, tap "Record fix" in "Issue tracking": write the corrective action, choose the date fixed, and add a photo after the fix (required for site inspection findings).
Tap "Fixed — close"; the person who found it and the supervisor are notified.
sections.tip: If you marked "Abnormal" by mistake, change it back to OK the same day and resend; the issue is cancelled automatically.

chapters.title: Unit supervisor
chapters.who: See progress, review monthly, assign work in your department

sections.title: Home and section status
sections.lead: See at a glance which sections have not checked today, where the issues are and how many reviews are waiting.
steps: To do: months waiting for your review are listed here. Tap "Start review".
Section status: one card per section; collapsed it shows today's progress, expanded it shows who did each form and how many days this month.
Sections with issues are listed first.

sections.title: Monthly review
sections.lead: After inspectors submit, you review, sign and approve; then it goes to EHS for archiving.
steps: Switch forms at the top to see the calendar or item table; for periodic inspections open the photos and notes.
If all is fine tap "Approve and sign"; your signature is added and a PDF is created.
If something is wrong, tap "Return" and tell the inspector in person what to fix; they fix it and resend.

sections.title: Department
sections.lead: Assign who handles which forms and equipment in your department; adjust here when staff change.
steps: On Home tap "Department"; it has three tabs: People, Forms, Equipment.
People: whether each person has signed in and signed, and what they handle; tap a person to tick their forms and equipment.
Forms / Equipment: current owner, last periodic inspection and deadline; tap an item to change its owner.
Then tap "Effective today" (changes now) or "From next month" (no change this month, switches on the 1st). People involved are notified.
sections.tip: To add or disable people, forms or equipment, ask the EHS Center.

sections.title: Archive
sections.lead: After the supervisor approves, EHS checks the PDF and archives it — the month is complete.
steps: On Home under "To do" tap "View PDF and archive".
Tap "Open PDF" to check; if fine tap "Approve and archive", otherwise return it.
PDFs are saved to Drive and the NAS automatically.

sections.title: Announcements
sections.lead: Send notices to everyone, selected departments or people, and see who hasn't read them.
steps: On Home tap "Announcements".
Choose recipients: everyone, selected departments (option: "Only to supervisors"), or selected people.
Write a title (shown at the top of Home) and content; tick "Also email" if needed.
Tap "Send announcement". Under "Sent announcements" see how many have read it; open one to see who has not.

sections.title: Post training and see read records
sections.lead: Send training or health info (text + PDF/pictures + link) to staff and see who opened and confirmed it.
steps: Menu → "EHS training" → "Post new item".

Training: hours, instructor, due date; upload Chinese and Thai versions and pick the language; add a quiz (up to 10 questions, all correct to pass). "I have completed it" signs staff in automatically.
Health info: reading only, no sign-in; you can ask staff to tap "I have read it".
Choose recipients and tap "Post". "Read records" shows who has finished; remove items you no longer need.
sections.tip: When everyone has finished, tap "Confirm sign-in complete · export to NAS" in the reading record. At 09:15 the next day the computer files the sign-in sheets (P-05-01-A, BU / PU) and materials in the training archive by year and topic.

sections.title: Developer mode (find where staff got stuck)
sections.lead: When someone reports a problem, go through the app with their screens to see what they see and where they got stuck. View only — nothing is sent in their name.
steps: At the bottom of the Menu tap "Developer mode". People with error reports in the last 30 days are listed first.
Tap a person to see their error messages, which screen, and the screens they went through before.
Tap "Enter as ○○○": an orange bar appears and you now see their screens; follow their steps.
At steps that would submit, sign or approve, "This step would submit" appears and nothing is sent. Tap "End" on the orange bar to go back to yourself.
sections.tip: Who viewed whose screens and when is logged in the back office. Phone error reports are kept for 90 days.

sections.title: Site inspection (monthly)
sections.lead: Inspect at least once a month (you can rotate through areas). Findings are filled in by tapping; the system opens issue tracking and files the record as EF-00-012-B on the NAS.
shots: This month and the last 12 months
Tap the responsible unit, common findings and regulations
steps: In the main menu tap "Site inspection" → "Start inspection" and tick the areas you visit (BU areas A–C, PU lines 1–5…).
Mark each of the 16 checkpoints ○ OK / × Needs fixing / － Not checked; tap "Mark the rest ○ OK" for the rest.
Each "×" item opens a finding card: tap the responsible unit and the common finding (the regulation is filled in for you), then add notes, a due date and photos if needed.
Tap "Send inspection record": findings go to the unit's "Issue tracking" and its supervisor gets an email. Units not on the App yet (e.g. areas B and C) are closed by EHS in issue tracking.
sections.tip: Every day at 09:15 the computer files the record as EF-00-012-B on the NAS; when all findings are fixed it saves a "fixes complete" copy with the after photos. If you leave halfway, the draft stays on the phone.

chapters.title: Menu
chapters.who: One app for all EHS work

sections.title: Menu and features
sections.lead: Daily checks, environmental readings, contractor work requests and training are all in one app. Open it and pick what to do.
steps: If you have two or more features, the app opens at the Menu. Tap what you need.
If you only have daily checks, the app opens straight there. "Menu" at top right takes you back any time.
Each card shows how many things are left today; a red number means not handled yet.
A red dot on the Menu button means new training you have not read.

sections.title: Features you cannot use yet
sections.lead: Grey cards with a lock are features you do not have access to yet.
steps: Tap a grey card and "No access" appears.
Tell your supervisor first; "Request access" notifies the EHS Center.
After the EHS Center turns it on, close and reopen the app.
sections.tip: Everyone has EHS training; no request needed.

sections.title: Courses and sign-in
sections.lead: For training, read the material, answer the quiz and tap "I have completed it" to sign in automatically. Health info only needs reading.
steps: On the Menu tap "EHS training"; Home also reminds you of courses to finish.
Open a course and read the material (PDF, pictures). If there is a Thai version and your phone is set to Thai, you see it first.
If there is a quiz, all answers must be correct; wrong ones turn red — read again and retry.
Tap "I have completed it (use my signature)"; your stored signature is added to the training sign-in sheet.
Health info only needs reading; tap "I have read it" where asked.
sections.tip: You need internet to view the materials. Just opening a course does not complete it; the reminder on the home page stays until you tap "I have completed it". Overdue courses are marked red.

chapters.title: Contractor work requests
chapters.who: When a contractor comes to work on site

sections.title: Send links to contractors
sections.lead: When a contractor will work here, send them the request links by LINE from this page.
steps: On the Menu tap "Contractor work requests".
New contractor: send "Contractor registration (Form 1)". They then get a commitment letter to stamp and return.
Each job: send "Work request (Form 2)"; the contractor fills it 3 working days before. Before sending, the app asks whether to add you as the person in charge; then the case appears under My cases.
Tap "Send to contractor" and choose LINE, or "Copy link" and paste it.

sections.title: Steps: what the contractor and I each do
sections.lead: After Form 2, everyone signs and EHS approves before the contractor may enter.
steps: Contractor: after Form 2 they get an email with signing links. The supervisor signs first, then each worker scans and signs.

You (person in charge): after the workers sign, "Sign in the app" appears under My cases and uses your stored signature after you confirm. When all workers have signed you can "Submit for review" right there.
Once all have signed it is submitted; EHS approves, and the contractor gets an approval email before entering.
For hot work, lifting, confined space or work at height, the contractor fills a permit on the day (the system emails the link).
If the contractor did not get the signing email, send the resend link at the bottom; it goes to their registered email.
sections.tip: Status: waiting for signatures → workers signing → in review → approved. If returned, remind the contractor to complete it.

sections.title: Daily readings
sections.lead: Air readings open the existing system for now; wastewater (new plant) readings are done in this app.
shots: Out of range needs a note
steps: On the Menu tap "Environmental readings" and choose air or wastewater.
For cumulative meters (flow meter, power meter), enter the number on the meter; the system works out daily usage.
Out of range, equipment marked ✕, or a problem found: the card turns red and you must write the cause and action to send.
The bottom button shows how many are left; when done tap "Send". Without internet it is saved on the phone and uploaded later. To correct the same day, open it again and resend.
sections.tip: Items and ranges are set in the back office and will be updated after the trial-run approval.

sections.title: Month-end confirmation
sections.lead: After each month, send it for confirmation; once confirmed it is locked.
steps: On the readings page tap "This month's records" to see each day and any problems; tap a day to view or fill it.
From the 1st of the next month tap "Send month ○ for confirmation".
Now two steps: reader sends → EHS confirms. When others take over it becomes three: reader → supervisor → EHS.
The approver can "Confirm" or "Return"; returned months can be corrected and sent again.

sections.title: Look up chemicals at your workplace
sections.lead: Tap "Hazardous chemicals" in the main menu to see every chemical on your division's list (PU or BU).
shots: Grouped like the list, with search
Tap to see the key hazards
steps: Tap "Hazardous chemicals" in the main menu and scroll; you can also search by name, CAS or index code.
The red diamonds on the right are GHS hazard pictograms (flammable, corrosive, health hazard…).
Tap an item to see its hazard classes and basic info; the original SDS is in the binder on site — find it by the index code.
sections.tip: EHS updates the list every quarter and the App switches to the new one automatically. Before work, read SDS section 8 (protective equipment) and section 4 (first aid).

faq: Can I fill in without a network?
Yes. It is saved on the phone and shows "waiting to upload"; it uploads automatically when online and will not be lost.
Made a mistake?
Open the same form the same day, edit and send again. If the month is already locked, ask your supervisor to return it first.
New phone or cleared the browser?
Just sign in again with your PIN; your signature is stored in the system, no need to sign again.
Forgot your PIN?
Ask the EHS Center to reset it. The old PIN will stop working.
Checks on your day off?
Send a link with "Ask a coworker to fill in", or fill it in on the calendar when you are back (marked as late entry).
New app version?
When "New app version" pops up, tap "Restart app". Records not yet uploaded are kept.
Can't see a form?
It is not assigned to you. Go to "My forms" → "Claim", or ask your supervisor to assign it in "Department".
Do yearly forms always need photos?
Yes. Yearly and 2-yearly inspections need site evidence: at least 2 photos + notes before they can be sent.
Must every issue be closed?
Yes. It stays in "Issue tracking" until a corrective action is recorded; supervisors and EHS see how many are open.
(EHS) Nobody can see the name list, or data suddenly will not load?

Usually the back-office spreadsheet was changed (for example a row inserted above the header, sorted, or deleted). The system fixes it when reading; you can also tap "Settings → System refresh" in the app, or the same item in the spreadsheet menu. No data is deleted. To view only one department, use the filter button in row 1 of the name list instead of hiding, moving or sorting rows.
(EHS) A labor inspection or audit wants records for certain months or forms?

Records are still archived to the NAS automatically after each monthly approval. When you need records separately, go to "Settings → Export records", tick the departments, month range and check forms, then tap "Create PDF". One file per department per month; several files are downloaded as one zip. Months not yet approved are exported only if you tick that option; those PDFs carry no unit head signature and the file name is marked as not approved.
